# Cap open work per agent

`customer_support.pb.queue_management.cap_open_work_per_agent` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **playbook**

> Limit how many tickets an agent holds open rather than pushing how many they close.

An agent juggling a wide open pile ages every item in it simultaneously. Constraining work in progress converts the same throughput into markedly lower wait, because tickets finish instead of all advancing slightly.
